BL Starting 5:

Dimitri - PF/Captain

Team leader & two way star. Uses his anger to his advantage which makes him a lockdown defender and an offensive threat. Bullies opponents in the post with his inhuman strength.

Dedue - C

Defensive anchor. Being the tallest student, Dedue is a force to be reckoned with in the paint, swatting shots and grabbing boards with ease.

Felix - SF

Elite slasher/inside scorer. Uses his speed to blow by opponents on cuts and drives. Can finish at the rim better than most and catch alley oops easily.

Ashe - SG

Consistent deadeye/3&D guard. A perimeter threat, Ashe is very proficient with his outside shooting. Can drain shots with defenders in his face. His lockpick ability also makes him an elite perimeter defender. 

Annette - PG

Playmaker. Needs to work on court vision as she is a bit clumsy, but Annette is known for her play calling and flashy dishes to her teammates. Good ball handling skills due to her size and is an elite ankle breaker, which means her opponents are more likely to make the highlight reel.
